title: A record as a foam
about: A market's record of movements read as one complex of events, subjects and holdings, after the generative-relational formalism: its spacetime, who has the better of whom in exchange, loops through time, the round of money, where new money goes first, the division of what is short, and what a record can tell two mechanisms apart. The mathematics is the markets domain's; its theory note says what is proved.
